verdict.rationale: Jules is a coding agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence shows Jules can connect to or use external MCP servers. The only MCP mention (jules-comm-19) is a user who built their own MCP server wrapping the Jules API so they could call Jules from Copilot. That is a user-side workaround running in the opposite direction, not Jules consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
